The intent classifier of a protected turn with a resolved provider: the turn's registry-resolved model behind the classifier boundary of the same scope (pseudonymized prompt, policy check, provider approval). Replaces the configured classifier model and callback.

Passes ctx.privacy?.boundary ?? null: the boundary of every protected turn. null when the handler was created without 'privacy', or with 'privacy' and policy.required: false for a turn whose signed policy is absent or 'off' (the policy's decision, reported as state 'off'); a protected block never runs with null. Upstream result-handle retrieval adds no new model/network call: effective protected turns never create the raw result store or builtin reader, and core bridges refuse externally registered SDK readers before execution; current, foreign/deleted/expired-generation and off-to-revoked HTTP transport regressions cover this boundary.
